name: RNDT catalogue
description: Search the Italian national catalogue of spatial data (RNDT) and add its WMS, WMTS and WFS services to the map.

assistant.description: Search RNDT, the Italian national catalogue of geospatial metadata (about 24,000 records of Italian public bodies: cadastre, hydrography, land use, hazards, orthophotos), and add its WMS, WMTS, WFS and ArcGIS layers to the map through the plugin's panel.
